title: Close the 71 Rust step gaps and fail cucumber on skipped steps
description: python3 tools/check_spec_parity.py --known /dev/null exits 1 with 71 Rust gaps (Python 0); they are tolerated through tools/parity/known_unimplemented_steps.txt, and rust/tests/cucumber.rs does not call fail_on_skipped(), so missing Rust steps skip silently. Groups: issue write API steps (~18), routing assignment editor steps (~10, Python-only agent_assignment_editing_steps.py), 'the environment variable KANBUS_* is set to' (~7), daemon diagnostics (4), console now mock summaries (3), .gitignore/project-local steps, 'I request the console now snapshot' (Rust has '... from the API'), and six plain-string Rust steps containing '/' (e.g. commit_steps.rs:15 'project/issues should be committed to git') which cucumber-rs parses as alternation and can never match; convert those to regex. Acceptance: known_unimplemented_steps.txt empty; check_spec_parity.py --known /dev/null exits 0; cucumber.rs uses fail_on_skipped (honouring @skip/@wip tags); cargo test --test cucumber green. Do after kbs-215bc6f0 lands (shared step files).
